journey.setup: Use the isolated synthetic DP780 fixture and existing Modeling route; do not mutate permanent demo data.
actions: Open /modeling?stage=data&family=metal and select Test Data CMP-DEMO-DP780-TEST-JSON revision rev1 titled Tensile test 0001.
Continue to Process, preserve the selected exact revision and graph, then open Fit with swift + voce 50/50 visible as the selected model.
Open Export and verify target abaqus/2025/kg_m_s, approximation openradioss/2025/kg_m_s and native DP780_C1_REFERENCE remain readable in their existing advanced/native surfaces.
Reload and read back the exact stage and session state without a first-item, latest, or cross-route fallback.
journey.visible_outcome: The Modeling shell, stage navigator, compact explorer, settings ribbon and persistent engineering graph retain their established hierarchy and reachability.
journey.persistence_readback: Exact Material/Test Data/model selection and stage state survive the existing reload/read-back contract; CSS ownership does not write or reinterpret state.
journey.recovery: A blocked/stale exact revision remains fail-closed with its recovery action and last valid graph; it must not silently select another revision.
negative_cases: Blocked stage readiness keeps Data, Process, Fit and Export controls rendered and reachable without inventing a preview.
A stale URL Material or Test Data revision is not replaced with latest or first-item data.
The compatibility alias /datasets/processing preserves the same layout contract without cross-route CSS contamination.
technical_cases: Frozen extended tuples, complete/mixed group boundaries, source order, at-context, specificity and important declarations remain equivalent.

Legacy complements and all 60 deferred identities remain exactly once in legacy CSS; CSS-1618/1619 retain their original styles.css producer/order, and each moved identity is exactly once in its truthful owner.
Production and Storybook CSS bundles preserve total-set identity counts and do not leak deferred identities into any isolated owner-named chunk.
Frontend guard and CSS inventory remain zero-violation and count-consistent.

capture_plan.crop_policy: direct 100%-pixel crops from the opened original; no resize, resampling, CSS zoom, or fabricated filler

matrix_rules.normal_states: MOD-DATA, MOD-PROCESS, MOD-FIT and MOD-EXPORT normal states require all five CSS viewports in both before and after phases.
matrix_rules.registered_exceptions: Service-reference exceptions and evidence-only states are required at their registered 1440x900 fixture viewport unless the state record explicitly expands the matrix.
matrix_rules.selector_scope: Every affected state records target selector matches. A state outside the M1E4 selector scope records match_count=0 and a machine-readable reason instead of blanket N/A.
matrix_rules.storybook: EngineeringCurvePlot EmptyCompatibleSeries is exactly 1440x900, browser zoom 100%, DPR 1.
matrix_rules.physical_readability: DEFERRED_TO_223; automated 3840x2160 is geometry evidence only.

na_proof.reason: MOD-PROCESS has no native solver preview target selector; Export owns that region.

Record mapping digest, target/approximation/native tuples, Solver Card id/revision, preview SHA and download SHA; do not freeze generated filename.
Any mapping status, acknowledgement, preview/download resource, target identity, native preview geometry or recovery difference blocks acceptance.
